front.title: Outerprise Ecosystem and Infrastructure: Visual Manual and Machine-Readable Companion

abstract.t: This document presents a visual reference model of the Outerprise evidence-delivery ecosystem as documented by the public Entercation application. It identifies participants, public surfaces, packet boundaries, fiscal-sponsorship stations, comparison findings and policy decisions. It describes a machine-readable companion with structured definitions, schemas, exact arithmetic and synthetic test vectors. The visual model is a documented public-surface view with explicit evidence boundaries.
